## AGENTS.md
    1  # AGENTS.md
    2  
    3  Guidance for AI agents (and humans) working in this repository. This is a
    4  condensed orientation focused on the non-obvious conventions and invariants
    5  that aren't immediately apparent from reading a single file. The authoritative
    6  sources for the details behind each section are `README.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
    7

## docs/llms.txt
    1  # Stella — complete documentation
    2  
    3  > Stella is a fast, bring-your-own-key, model-agnostic terminal coding agent. Point it at any provider, give it a goal, and let a verifier decide when the work is done.
    4  
    5  This file is the full text of every page on the Stella documentation site,
    6  concatenated in the site's own navigation order. It is generated from the site
    7  sources, so it is the same content as https://stella.oxagen.sh/docs rather than a summary of it.
    8  
    9  - Site: https://stella.oxagen.sh/docs
